title: v1_87 / Notebooks
content: ## Notebooks ### Indentation settings for notebooks We now support notebook-specific indentation settings via the notebook.editorOptionsCustomizations setting. This setting allows users to set a specific indentation style for notebooks, via the `editor.tabSize`, `editor.indentSize`, and `editor.insertSpaces` settings. Users will also notice a status bar entry named **Notebook Indentation** that shows the current indentation settings for the notebook editor. This entry has a quick pick menu, which enables managing the indentation settings without having to open the Settings editor. This is the same quick pick menu that is also available in the editor.
